mapper.select: SELECT user_id as userId, nickname, user_name as name, email, DATE_FORMAT(birth_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as birthDate, gender, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as joinedAt, profile_image as profileImage FROM USER WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT ubr.intimacy_id as level, ubr.current_exp as remainPoint FROM USER_BOT_RELATION ubr JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON ubr.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT name, CASE WHEN unlock_intimacy_level > #{userLevel} THEN '잠금' ELSE '보유' END as state FROM CHAT_BACKGROUND ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT motion_name as name, CASE WHEN unlock_intimacy_level > #{userLevel} THEN '잠금' WHEN motion_group = 'COMMON' THEN '기본' ELSE '보유' END as tag FROM BOT_MOTION WHERE bot_id = ( SELECT e.bot_id FROM EXCLUSIVE e WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.exclusive_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY motion_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOT_LETTER bl JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON bl.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND bl.is_read = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOT_LETTER bl JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON bl.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND bl.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)

SELECT bl.letter_id as id, blt.name as type, '메이티' as sender, bl.title, bl.content as preview, CASE WHEN DATE(bl.created_at) = CURDATE() THEN '오늘' WHEN DATE(bl.created_at) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN '어제' ELSE DATE_FORMAT(bl.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') END as date, NOT bl.is_read as unread FROM BOT_LETTER bl JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON bl.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id JOIN BOT_LETTER_TYPE blt ON bl.letter_type_id = blt.letter_type_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY bl.created_at DESC

SELECT b.name AS "botName", u.nickname AS "userNickname", /* 해당 사용자가 이 봇과 나눈 상담 총 횟수 */ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COUNSEL_SUMMARY cs2 JOIN CHAT_ROOM cr2 ON cs2.chat_room_id = cr2.chat_room_id JOIN EXCLUSIVE e2 ON cr2.exclusive_id = e2.exclusive_id WHERE e2.user_id = u.user_id AND e2.bot_id = b.bot_id) AS "counselCount", m.risk_level AS "riskLevel", cs.content AS "content" FROM COUNSEL_SUMMARY cs JOIN CHAT_ROOM cr ON cs.chat_room_id = cr.chat_room_id JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON cr.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id JOIN BOT b ON e.bot_id = b.bot_id JOIN USER u ON e.user_id = u.user_id JOIN MESSAGE m ON cs.end_message_id = m.message_id WHERE cs.counsel_id = #{counselId}

SELECT us.bot_letter_enabled as pushNotice, us.satisfaction_popup_enabled as satisfactionPopup, u.is_marketing_agreed as marketingNotice, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'BOT_MESSAGE'), 1) as noti_BOT_MESSAGE, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'CHAT_REMINDER'), 1) as noti_CHAT_REMINDER, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'COMMENT_REPLY'), 1) as noti_COMMENT_REPLY, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'COMMUNITY_HOT'), 1) as noti_COMMUNITY_HOT, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'EVENT_NOTICE'), 1) as noti_EVENT_NOTICE, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'POINT_REWARD'), 1) as noti_POINT_REWARD, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'POST_COMMENT'), 1) as noti_POST_COMMENT, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'REPORT_RESULT'), 1) as noti_REPORT_RESULT, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'SUPPORT_ANSWER'), 1) as noti_SUPPORT_ANSWER, COALESCE((SELECT is_enabled FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_code = 'SYSTEM_NOTICE'), 1) as noti_SYSTEM_NOTICE FROM USER_SETTING us JOIN USER u ON us.user_id = u.user_id WHERE us.user_id = #{userId}

choose.otherwise:
UPDATE USER_SETTING
bot_letter_enabled = #{value}, satisfaction_popup_enabled = #{value},
updated_at = NOW()
WHERE user_id = #{userId}
